headline: Nvidia beats expectations on third-quarter revenue
summary: Nvidia reported third-quarter revenue above expectations and forecast fourth-quarter revenue of $130 billion, above the analyst average of $125.25 billion compiled by LSEG.
why: Nvidia is the leading supplier of AI accelerator chips, so its revenue and guidance are closely watched as a gauge of demand for AI infrastructure.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Revenue beat and above-consensus fourth-quarter guidance directly reflect on the company's results.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Revenue topped expectations and fourth-quarter guidance of $130 billion came in above the LSEG-compiled analyst average of $125.25 billion.
